title: Creative Oasis Near Nashville
description: With a blend of serenity & modern comfort, our home is conveniently located just 15 miles north of Nashville and only minutes away from Hendersonville’s lakes & parks. From the moment you step inside, you’ll be greeted by an abundance of natural light. The spacious deck & fire pit allow for plenty of space to enjoy beautiful views of nature and the breathtaking TN sunset. Our home provides the perfect balance between peaceful seclusion and easy access to entertainment & the vibrant music scene.

My name is Liliana. As a child I was called LILA. I’m an author, singer-songwriter, illustrator, and entrepreneur. After a difficult chapter in my life, I spent years rebuilding and creating a new path forward. In the process, I learned that no matter what—there’s always a silver lining. I raised three great sons on my own, and now I hope to have time to return to music, writing, and creating dream spaces—for myself and those who choose to visit.
